Sixteen Thousand on One Ship | Grandpa Walt, Ep. 2
1943. A troop train, a gray ocean liner and sixteen thousand people on one ship. Grandpa Walt tells the grandkids about the bunk he shared with a man he never met, the Queen Mary's zigzag across the Atlantic, and a handshake on a gangway in Scotland. Watch Ep. 1: https://youtu.be/9B9YuoAChWo Walt is a fictional character. The history is real. #GrandpaWalt #WWII #QueenMary #Storytime #History

The Sunday the Radio Went Quiet | Grandpa Walt, Ep. 1
Summer 2004, an Ohio porch. Grandpa Walt tells the grandkids about the church picnic where nobody ate, a flour tin, Uncle Earl's radio, and the girl with the ribbon, all on the Sunday the radio went quiet: December 7, 1941. Walt is a fictional character. The history is real. #GrandpaWalt #WWII #Storytime #History #PearlHarbor
